name: IP Blocklist
summary: Aggregated IP blocklists for inbound and outbound traffic, refreshed every two hours.
description: Text blocklists for firewalls, ad-blockers and security tools: inbound.txt lists IPs/networks with a bad reputation (spam, scanning, SSH/RDP brute force, web exploits), outbound.txt lists malicious destinations such as C2 servers, botnet controllers, malware drop sites and phishing hosts. Both are aggregated from public feeds and updated every 2 hours, with exclusions for major public DNS resolvers.
contains: inbound.txt: sources of spam, scanning, brute force and web exploits
outbound.txt: C2 servers, botnet controllers, malware drop sites, phishing hosts
updated every 2 hours; exclusions for major public DNS resolvers
plain text files for firewalls, ad-blockers and security tools
